# CI/CD Challenge (Implement This)

Do **not** treat CI/CD as pre-provided in this repository.

Your task is to design and add a workflow in this directory (for example, `ci.yml`) that validates the monorepo and demonstrates good delivery practices.

## Minimum expectations

- Trigger on pull requests and pushes to `main`.
- Use Node.js 20.
- Use modern Yarn (v4 via Corepack).
- Install dependencies with an immutable install.
- Run workspace build and any additional quality checks you choose.

## What we are looking for

- Clear pipeline stages and naming.
- Fast feedback loops.
- Stability and confidence in changes.
- Thoughtful trade-offs documented in PR notes or README updates.
